counting_policy: One independently meaningful contract per named method; configurations, assertions and repetitions never count as cases.

test_go_branch_counts_and_three_binding_.compatibility: Ordinary if/else; initializer clauses become explicit helper scope.
test_go_branch_counts_and_three_binding_.new_contract: One nine-branch count sequence and explicit initializer/body/outer shadow levels.

test_else_if_conditions_stop_after_selec.compatibility: Original effectful extension of ordinary Go if chain, no initializer syntax.
test_else_if_conditions_stop_after_selec.new_contract: Else-if condition effects stop at the selected arm and restart on the next call.

test_condition_record_rechecks_after_con.compatibility: Original loop-condition/record-return composition using ordinary Boolean conditions.
test_condition_record_rechecks_after_con.new_contract: Returned condition records distinguish condition reevaluation after continue from break.

test_nested_range_endpoint_effects_are_p.compatibility: Ordinary range iteration; original endpoint-call scheduling, no Swift slice representation.
test_nested_range_endpoint_effects_are_p.new_contract: Nested range bounds run left-to-right once per loop entry, including an empty range.

test_loop_shadow_initializer_escapes_bef.compatibility: Explicit managed shadow and construction; Go short declarations and Zig splat excluded.
test_loop_shadow_initializer_escapes_bef.new_contract: Per-iteration same-name initializer reads outer record and escapes before continue.

test_unused_nested_boolean_literals_keep.compatibility: Unused nested Lists and Boolean effects; no Zig result-location or comptime claim.
test_unused_nested_boolean_literals_keep.new_contract: Unused nested Boolean literal keeps depth-first effects and skips short-circuited elements.

test_nested_constructor_effects_follow_s.compatibility: Original nested constructor effects; explicit named fields, no Swift value-copy rule.
test_nested_constructor_effects_follow_s.new_contract: Reordered outer fields interleave nested literal and record initialization depth-first.

test_three_arguments_capture_old_replace.compatibility: Shared initialized records; original three-argument replacement schedule.
test_three_arguments_capture_old_replace.new_contract: Same call sees old record argument, replacement result, then new field scalar in that order.

test_compound_index_update_captures_betw.compatibility: Original compound scalar write; no pointer result-location equivalence.
test_compound_index_update_captures_betw.new_contract: Compound indexed update captures value after index effects and before RHS mutation.

test_loop_field_replacement_keeps_storag.compatibility: Ordinary iteration of a shared List projected from a record.
test_loop_field_replacement_keeps_storag.new_contract: Replacing iterable record field keeps original loop storage while later element mutation stays visible.

test_mixed_wide_record_survives_recursiv.compatibility: Original mixed wide record; explicit fields/ordinary recursion, no Swift struct ABI/copy claim.
test_mixed_wide_record_survives_recursiv.new_contract: Eight mixed-kind slots survive recursive return and reference-field overwrite with old alias retained.

test_interval_algebra_returns_independen.compatibility: Named interval helpers replace operators/tuples; mutation uses Minyar shared record semantics.
test_interval_algebra_returns_independen.new_contract: Interval negate/add/subtract composition creates independent endpoint records before input mutation.

test_mixed_record_branch_returns_preserv.compatibility: Original mixed record selected through early and fallthrough return paths.
test_mixed_record_branch_returns_preserv.new_contract: Distinct mixed scalar/reference field kinds retain named mapping on both return paths.

test_returned_ragged_record_topology_kee.compatibility: Ragged Lists of explicit records; fixed-array layout, default fields and comptime excluded.
test_returned_ragged_record_topology_kee.new_contract: Returned three-level ragged record topology includes an empty middle row and named field mapping.

test_fresh_and_shared_record_fill_have_d.compatibility: Fresh explicit constructors versus repeated same record; no splat/copy or record equality.
test_fresh_and_shared_record_fill_have_d.new_contract: Record filling distinguishes each fresh cell from deliberately shared cells after field mutation.

test_shared_record_fields_diverge_on_one.compatibility: Original record field rebinding; sharing intentionally differs from Zig implicit copy.
test_shared_record_fields_diverge_on_one.new_contract: Two record fields initially share one List then diverge through one field replacement and helper identity.

test_borrowed_nested_record_returns_afte.compatibility: Original borrowed nested record return after last parent replacement inside the helper.
test_borrowed_nested_record_returns_afte.new_contract: A loop-selected nested record survives parent replacement before return, preserving a mutable nested List.

test_managed_loop_binding_survives_slot_.compatibility: Managed iteration binding differs from scalar snapshots; original overwrite/continue/break composition.
test_managed_loop_binding_survives_slot_.new_contract: Managed record iteration retains old element across overwrite, parent rebinding and loop transfers.

test_deep_snapshot_and_sibling_aliases_s.compatibility: Explicit two-level scalar snapshot versus shared nested List aliases, no implicit deep copy.
test_deep_snapshot_and_sibling_aliases_s.new_contract: Deep row snapshot remains independent while sibling shared paths split on inner replacement.

test_record_bytes_slice_keeps_numeric_sn.compatibility: Original Bytes field/slice extension of record replacement and explicit-copy controls; no upstream binary format claim.
test_record_bytes_slice_keeps_numeric_sn.new_contract: Returned Bytes slice is independent of a shared record field after typed numeric writes and parent rebinding.

test_rational_normalization_moves_sign_a.compatibility: Original rational normalization with representable abs inputs; no std::gcd API/constexpr/unsigned behavior.
test_rational_normalization_moves_sign_a.new_contract: Euclid feeds returned numerator/denominator normalization, sign movement and zero canonicalization.

test_ragged_gcd_fold_returns_scalars_ind.compatibility: Original Euclidean fold over ordinary ragged Lists; peer gcd API excluded.
test_ragged_gcd_fold_returns_scalars_ind.new_contract: Repeated gcd composition across empty, zero and signed rows yields independent returned records after source mutation.

test_extrema_initializer_captures_before.compatibility: Original extrema record initializer with intervening shared mutation; no C++ reference identity.
test_extrema_initializer_captures_before.new_contract: Min snapshot precedes mutation helper while max uses changed source in the same returned constructor.

test_divmod_record_recomposes_saved_oper.compatibility: Original quotient/remainder record snapshot and recomposition; no Go overflow-wrap minimum/-1 behavior.
test_divmod_record_recomposes_saved_oper.new_contract: Signed divmod returns a scalar record that recomposes the original operands after shared input overwrite.

test_signed_shift_results_pack_in_order_.compatibility: Representable Integer shifts followed by original binary packing; no Go unsigned width or overshift parity.
test_signed_shift_results_pack_in_order_.new_contract: Arithmetic right shift and checked left shift feed an eight-byte little-endian roundtrip across record return.
